newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: FOCUS-St George sees mortgage pressures.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-St George sees mortgage pressures.

text.p: Australia's largest and hungriest regional bank, St George Bank Ltd, on Tuesday posted a 34 percent jump in first half net profit but alerted investors that competitors would place more pressure on mortgage rate margins.
Net profit for the six months to March 31, climbed to A$99.7 million from A$74.5 million a year earlier.
The result was boosted by a two month contribution from Sydney-based rival Advance Bank Ltd which it acquired in January for about A$2.6 billion.
The profit result was in line with expectations.
St George shares ended steady at A$8.15 but retreated from their intraday and year's high of A$8.28.

"The directors anticipate continued downward pressure on interest margins in the second half of the year due primarily to recent competitive initiatives on residential lending rates," St George said in a statement accompanying its result.

In the past two years, Australian banks have been squeezed by non-bank lenders, who, funded by the wholesale fund markets, have cut mortgage rates well ahead of that which banks would otherwise offer.
